<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="20014026" href="/id/perpustakaan/alkitab/alkitab-pelajaran/buku-buku/amsal/14/#v20014026" target="_blank">Amsal 14:26</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Yehuwa, Engkau mengulurkan</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">Harapan yang indah,</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">Yang kami senang bagikan</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">Kepada dunia.</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">Tetapi kadang kami resah,</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">Dan kami putus asa.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">Harapan kami yang cerah</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">Redup seketika.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 se"><span id="page9" class="pageNum refID" aria-hidden="true" data-no="9" data-before-text="9"> </span>(REFREIN)</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">Engkaulah kekuatan dan keyakinan,</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">Serta harapan sejati.</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">Kami ’kan mengabar dengan tak ragu</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">Kar’na bersandar pada-Mu.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sl"><span id="page10" class="pageNum refID" aria-hidden="true" data-no="10" data-before-text="10"> </span><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>Yehuwa, bantu kami ingat:</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">Kami tak sendiri</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">Kar’na Kau selalu dekat,</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">Siap hibur kami.</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp">Semangat kami Kau kobarkan.</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">Kami pun bangkit lagi,</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">Berani, bangga nyatakan</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sz">Nama-Mu yang suci.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 se">(REFREIN)</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">Engkaulah kekuatan dan keyakinan,</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">Serta harapan sejati.</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">Kami ’kan mengabar dengan tak ragu</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">Kar’na bersandar pada-Mu.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 se">(Lihat juga <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19072013-19072014" href="/id/perpustakaan/alkitab/alkitab-pelajaran/buku-buku/mazmur/72/#v19072013-v19072014" target="_blank">Mz. 72:13, 14;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="20003005-20003006" href="/id/perpustakaan/alkitab/alkitab-pelajaran/buku-buku/amsal/3/#v20003005-v20003006" target="_blank"> Ams. 3:5, 6,</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="20003026" href="/id/perpustakaan/alkitab/alkitab-pelajaran/buku-buku/amsal/3/#v20003026" target="_blank"> 26;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="24017007" href="/id/perpustakaan/alkitab/alkitab-pelajaran/buku-buku/yeremia/17/#v24017007" target="_blank"> Yer. 17:7</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p31" class="displayNone"> </p>
